disposition.note: AC6: a failed or silent consumed call fails the run. The owner's message ID is reported where the service answers. The no-answer message is Not specified.

edits.old: And the run report names the owning service and the message ID
edits.new: And the run report names the owning service and, where the service answers, the message ID

edits.old: The seeding set and the harness environment: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0444; ASM-0636).
edits.new: The seeding set contents and the harness environment beyond the harness pack below: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0444; ASM-0636).

findings.issue: AC6 says the run report names the message ID even when the call gets no answer, so no message ID exists. The note still claims the owner's message for a silent call.
Section 11 calls the seeding set and harness environment Not specified (GAP-0444), then says the harness pack sets the SIT hosts and the stub-served seeding set. The two contradict.
